claim: For each user pool or other authentication provider that you configure for an identity pool, you can create up to 25 role-based access control (RBAC) rules, and this limit is not adjustable.
question: How many role-based access control rules can you create per authentication provider in an Amazon Cognito identity pool?

qualifiers.scope: per authentication provider (user pool or other provider) configured for an identity pool

evidence.quote: | Role-based access control (RBAC) rules | 25 | No | N/A |
For each user pool or other authentication provider that you configure for an identity pool, you can create up to 25 rules. This limit is not adjustable.
